_core: Google's PRIMARY category says this is an HVAC shop. Any of these keeps the lead.
_conditional: Primary is something broader. Kept only when the NAME says heating or cooling AND an HVAC category sits somewhere in the list. Catches 'Smith Plumbing, Heating & Cooling', drops 'PM Plumbing & Mechanical'.
_name_deny: Drops the lead whatever its category. Whole words, case-insensitive.
_franchises: Big brands and national chains. Whole-word match on the name, case-insensitive.
_max_reviews: Above this the shop is too big to be an owner-operator.
_service: Every HVAC lead is 'AC and furnace' (Jake, 2026-10-06). The boiler / heat pump name rules were dropped; service_rules still works for a trade that wants sub-categories (read from the NAME only, first match wins, nothing matches = default).
_line_types: Twilio line_type_intelligence types that get a text.
